2/ MMA repurchase facility was introduced on 23 Nov 2006 replacing the Lombard facility.
3/ MMA introduced overnight deposit facility for commercial banks effective from 23 March 2010.
4/ Effective from 9th May 2010 MMA introduced Overnight Lombard facility replacing repurchase facility rate.
5/ Loans and advances min and max rates include the pen.a.l rates charged on unplanned advances or overdrafts and overdue installments.

6/ The Government of Maldives introduced Treasury bills on 11 Sep, 2006. With effective from 27 December 2009 the T-bill rates represents the current weighted average interest rate offered by the government.
7/ MAISX is calculated since the inception of Securites Trading Floor (Maldives Stock Exchange) on 5 May 2002.
